title: Motion planning for TIAGo
summary: Bachelor’s thesis investigating collision-free motion planning for a redundant robot.
overview: The thesis addresses motion planning for a redundant manipulator in pick-and-place scenarios.
constraints: Feasible paths and computation time compete with path quality in cluttered scenes.
contribution: My bachelor’s thesis at UNIVPM focused on robot motion planning.
approach: The previous CV and portfolio describe investigation of RRT and RRT* and their planning trade-offs.
results: The thesis is part of my completed undergraduate work. The full report will provide the benchmark conditions and detailed results.
limits: Algorithm comparisons need their actual scenario definitions and metrics. This summary does not imply physical robot deployment.
